content: For each task, we used 80% of the dataset for training our model and 10% for tuning the hyperparameters of our models. Finally, we evaluated all of our models on the remaining 10% (Table 1 and Table 2 ). For causal explanation detection task, we extracted discourse arguments using our parser and selected discourse arguments which most cover the annotated causal explanation text span as our gold standard.
